Name: CAN_HRDEM
Title: High Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) Mosaic
Description: Natural Resources Canada OGC Web Map Service (WMS) for the High Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) Mosaic. The HRDEM Mosaic is a continuous elevation product covering the Canadian landmass. It is derived from the High Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) data which is produced from airborne LiDAR data.
